home.title: Home
home.content:
A small studio with a big timetable

Hathaflow is a sample yoga studio. It is here to show what the booking system does: a weekly timetable with live free places, booking and payment on the site, class passes and memberships, private and online sessions, gift cards, reminders and a student account.

Click around as a student would: open a class, book it, try the account. Payments run in test mode, so nothing is charged.

about.title: About the studio
about.excerpt: Hathaflow is a demo studio for the booking system: what it shows and how to try it.
about.seo_desc: Hathaflow is a demo yoga studio that shows a complete booking system: timetable, booking, payments, passes, memberships, private and online sessions.
about.content:
A demo studio

Hathaflow is not a real studio. The classes, times, prices and pictures are examples, put here so that you can see the booking system working with real-looking content.

What you can try

  • Book a group class from the timetable, with a drop-in or a pass.
  • Buy a class pass or a membership (test payment).
  • Request a private session: the studio answers with a time and a price.
  • Join the waiting list of a full class.
  • Open your account: bookings, passes, membership, history.

For the studio

Behind the site there is a studio admin: weekly class templates, class lists and check-in, payments and income, passes and memberships, private session requests, coupons, gift cards, newsletters and email templates. Online classes get their Zoom links automatically.

classes.title: Classes
classes.excerpt: Hatha flow, slow flow and live online classes: the pace changes, the care stays the same.
classes.seo_desc: Hatha flow, slow flow and live online yoga classes at the Hathaflow demo studio.
classes.content:
Every class has breathwork, strength, stretching, balance and a long relaxation at the end. What changes is the pace.

[oy_classes]

Which class should I choose?

New to yoga? Start with Slow Flow, or book a private session to learn the basics one-on-one.

Already active? Hatha Flow will keep you busy.

At home tonight? Join online, live.

private-yoga.title: Private sessions
private-yoga.excerpt: One-on-one yoga in the studio or online, planned around your body and your goals.
private-yoga.seo_title: Private yoga sessions | Hathaflow demo studio
private-yoga.seo_desc: Request a private yoga session in the studio or online: the studio replies with a time and a price you can pay in one click.
private-yoga.content:
A class for one

In a private session the class is planned for one person: your shoulders after a long week at the desk, the knee you are careful with, the calm you would like to find. 60, 75 or 90 minutes, in the studio or online.

How it works

  1. Send a request with a few times that suit you.
  2. The studio replies with an offer: a time and a price.
  3. Pay with one click, or use a private session from a pack.

hatha-flow.title: Hatha Flow
hatha-flow.excerpt: The dynamic class: breath-led sequences, strength, balance and a flow to get lost in.
hatha-flow.seo_title: Hatha Flow yoga class | Hathaflow demo studio
hatha-flow.content:
What happens in class

We arrive with a few minutes of breathing, warm up with sun salutations, build strength in standing sequences and finish with balance work and a long relaxation.

Who it is for

For people who move regularly and like a class that keeps them busy. Every pose has an easier and a harder version.

slow-flow.title: Slow Flow
slow-flow.excerpt: The gentle class: longer holds, more time for breath, open to every level.
slow-flow.seo_title: Slow Flow yoga class | Hathaflow demo studio
slow-flow.content:
What happens in class

The same building blocks as Hatha Flow, at a slower pace: longer holds, more time to notice, plenty of rest.

Who it is for

Beginners, people coming back after a break, and anyone who wants a quieter evening.

online-yoga.title: Online Yoga
online-yoga.excerpt: Selected classes live on Zoom, with the same booking and the same passes.
online-yoga.seo_title: Live online yoga classes | Hathaflow demo studio
online-yoga.content:
A live class at home

Online classes are live: the teacher sees the group and adjusts the class. The Zoom link arrives by email after booking and waits in your account.

What you need

A mat, a quiet corner and a device with a camera.

faqs.q: What happens if a class is full?
faqs.a: Join the waiting list. If a place opens, students with a pass or membership are booked in automatically; the others get an email.
Yes: book a place for a guest with your pass or pay for their ticket. Your guest gets their own confirmation.

faqs.q: How long are class passes valid?
faqs.a: The 5-class pass is valid for 90 days, the online 10-class pass for 6 months. Memberships renew monthly and can be cancelled any time.

how-to-choose-your-first-class.title: How to choose your first class
how-to-choose-your-first-class.excerpt: Slow or dynamic, studio or online: a short guide for the first visit.
how-to-choose-your-first-class.content:
The first class is easier when you know what to expect. If you are new or coming back after a break, start with Slow Flow. If you already move regularly, Hatha Flow will feel right. Can't make it to the studio? Join online.

Before you come

Eat lightly, bring water and arrive ten minutes early so there is time to say hello.

breathing-before-bed.title: A breathing exercise before bed
breathing-before-bed.excerpt: Four counts in, six counts out: a two-minute exercise for a calmer evening.
breathing-before-bed.content: A longer exhale tells the body it is safe to slow down. Sit or lie comfortably, breathe in through the nose for four counts and out for six. Ten rounds are enough.

what-a-class-pass-is-for.title: Drop-in, pass or membership?
what-a-class-pass-is-for.excerpt: Which option suits a weekly practice, and which suits the odd class.
what-a-class-pass-is-for.content: A drop-in suits the occasional class. A 5-class pass costs less per class and works for any group class. A membership suits a weekly habit: it renews monthly and can be cancelled any time.
